description: This file handles processing of permalinks within shared channels in Mattermost, including converting permalinks to remote sites and from remote sites, using regex patterns and URL parsing.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling permalink processing in shared channels.

methods.name: processPermalinkToRemote
methods.description: Processes permalinks in a post message to convert local permalinks to shared (remote) permalinks.

methods.name: processPermalinkFromRemote
methods.description: Processes permalinks in a post message received from a remote site, converting them to local permalinks.
